panels.gesture: A warm welcoming small smile, attentive eyes; one hand raised loosely near shoulder height, palm angled toward the unseen visitor, other hand open low.
Engaged calm speech, lips naturally parted, brows attentive; both hands apart at lower chest height, palms obliquely inward as if carefully explaining a point.
Thoughtful eyes glance slightly aside, brows gently knit; fingertips rest against the chin while the opposite hand lightly supports that elbow.
One eyebrow raised, the other slightly lowered, questioning half-open mouth; one forearm folded low and the other palm up near the chest, head tilted a little.
Quiet focused eyes, mouth closed and a slight sympathetic head inclination; hands loosely nested at the lower edge of the frame, shoulders composed, actively listening.
Sincere appreciative smile and a small head incline; one flat hand over the heart, the other opened toward the unseen listener.
Polite but firm small closed-mouth expression and a slightly concerned brow; one hand raised palm outward in a restrained gentle refusal, other hand low.
Clear engaged speaking expression; one open hand extends gently to the side to indicate a direction or invite someone to continue, other palm kept near the chest. Do not point straight into the lens.
Quiet intent side glance, lips slightly parted; one cupped hand beside the mouth without covering the face, slight forward incline, opposite forearm relaxed across lower torso.
